content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Manchester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree and defined hours of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your education and paid work leading projects. Granite PM Academy can clarify requirements specific to your background.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions at your own pace while maintaining full-time work. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world scenarios and exam-aligned content across the five process groups—no self-paced recordings or asynchronous modules.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply through PMI's official portal with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam registration fee at application. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance on form completion and submission to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, simulations, and targeted review—to reinforce bootcamp material. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center when ready. Our instructors remain available for clarification on complex topics before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle through PMI-approved activities, training, and project work. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting PDU documentation and the renewal fee to PMI. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education resources to support your renewal timeline.
